name: sgs/form
title: SGS Form
description: Form wrapper with multi-step support, validation, and email notifications to the site owner and the submitter.

field-background.reason: A form field has no hover ground; its focused ground is the separate Focused field background colour row (fieldFocusBackground), because the field element's focus state also carries border, ring and width that a colour tab could not hold.

field-text.reason: The typed text keeps one colour in every state: focus changes the field's ground, border and ring only (fieldFocus* rows), and a field has no hover look for its text.

field-focus-background.reason: The focused field ground is itself the focus state of the field control; a hover on an already-focused field has no separate look, and fieldBackground carries the resting and hover grounds.

field-focus-border.reason: The focused field border colour is itself the focus state of the field control; a hover on an already-focused field has no separate look, and fieldBorderColour carries the resting border.

field-focus-ring.reason: The focus ring colour is the focus state by definition (it paints on :focus-visible through the focus system's contract properties); a ring has no hover state.

step-label-active.label: Active step label
step-label-active._note: Colour of the active step's label; render.php prints a scoped rule on .{uid} .sgs-form__progress-step--active .sgs-form__progress-step-label. Unset keeps the stylesheet's text token.
step-label-active.absentWhy: The step navigation, progress bar and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

step-label-completed.label: Completed step label
step-label-completed._note: Colour and weight of the label of a step the visitor has passed (view.js toggles sgs-form__progress-step--completed). Unset keeps the not-active label colour.
step-label-completed.absentWhy: The step navigation and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

progress-track.label: Progress track
progress-track._note: The track behind the progress fill. progressTrackColour paints it; progressTrackHeight (per device) sets its height and the fill follows it. When either is set the track is clipped to a pill shape so the fill stays inside it. Unset keeps the bare 4px fill.
progress-track.absentWhy: The step navigation, progress bar and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

step-counter-name.label: Step counter step name
step-counter-name._note: The current step's name beside the counter. stepCounterNameSuffix sets the wording and turns it on; stepCounterNameHidden (per device, true hides) chooses where it shows.
step-counter-name.absentWhy: The counter prints only for a multi-step form with the Step counter switch on.

status-row.label: Counter and saved-progress row
status-row._note: The row holding the step counter and the saved-progress notice. statusRowWrap lets them wrap onto two lines in a narrow form; statusRowGap (per device) spaces the lines.
status-row.absentWhy: The row prints only for a multi-step form with the Step counter switch on.

actions-note.label: Note beside the buttons
actions-note._note: The note at the left of the buttons row. actionsNoteHidden (per device, true hides) removes it on the devices chosen; the first-step-only switch is separate. Its type is the help text's.
actions-note.absentWhy: The note prints only when Note beside the buttons has text; the single-step fixture leaves it empty.

actions.label: Form buttons row
actions._note: The form buttons row: a flex row; the wrap setting chooses between one line and wrapping onto further rows. actionsSticky (per device, off by default) pins the row to the bottom of the viewport while the form is on screen; actionsStickyBackground, actionsStickyBorderColour (1px top line), actionsStickyPadding (box), actionsStickyShadow (+Colour) and actionsStickyBleed (negative side margin, so the row spans a padded card) style it. render.php prints them only on the devices where sticky is on.

step-number-completed.label: Completed step number
step-number-completed._note: The bubble of a step the visitor has passed. Unset keeps it the same as the active step. stepCompletedIcon=tick swaps its number for a check mark.
step-number-completed.absentWhy: The step navigation prints only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: WS-4 composite wrapper — outer wrapper emitted by SGS_Container_Wrapper('layout', render.php:366-382), inheriting sgs/container's full LAYOUT-scope capabilities. color/typography/border are block-private, scoped via render.php:131-198 (mirrors sgs/container's render.php pattern).

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: composite wrapper grid capability (shared SGS_Container_Wrapper, kind='layout'). Maps explicitly — no `prefix` declared, so the default convention cannot resolve bare camelCase attrs (ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1).

submit-button.label: Submit button
submit-button._note: submitColour/submitBackground resolve via the default {prefix}{suffix} convention (Colour/Background suffixes). Rendered as a scoped rule on `.uid .sgs-form__button--submit` (render.php, contract §A) — not inline. submitBackgroundGradient's attrMap entry exists because the default convention has no Gradient-suffix awareness, so the gradient sibling would otherwise float as an unclaimed orphan. submitBackgroundHover/submitBackgroundHoverGradient are painted through sgs_fill_decls()/sgs_emit_state_colour_css(), with an explicit hover attrMap for the same reason. The submit* typography family (size, weight, style, family, transform, decoration, line-height, letter-spacing, alignment, wrap, columns, writing mode) is painted on `.sgs-form__button--submit` by sgs_typography_css_rule( $attributes, 'submit', … ) in render.php. The stylesheet's own button typography is a :where() default on `.sgs-form__button`, so an unset control leaves the look unchanged. Previous-step and Next buttons keep that default; they have no typography controls.

prev-button.label: Previous-step button
prev-button._note: The multi-step form's Previous button (.sgs-form__button--prev), distinct from submit-button. Added 2026-09-03 alongside the hover-colour + gradient migration off a hardcoded style.css :hover rule -- render.php calls sgs_button_element_style_css() with prefix 'prev', which reads exactly this attrMap shape by $prefix.'Suffix' concatenation.
prev-button.absentWhy: The step navigation, progress bar and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

next-button.label: Next-step button
next-button._note: The multi-step form's Next button (.sgs-form__button--next), the twin of prev-button. render.php calls sgs_button_element_style_css() with prefix 'next'. Its typography is the shared nav-button surface.
next-button.absentWhy: The step navigation, progress bar and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

progress-bar.label: Progress bar
progress-bar._note: progressBarColour drives the `--sgs-progress-colour` custom-property value; progressBarColourGradient drives the `--sgs-progress-colour-gradient` sibling (2026-09-04). Both are custom-property-fed (not real declarations), so mapped explicitly. The gradient wins when set (render.php line 290 uses sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). progressBarColourHover/progressBarColourHoverGradient (2026-09-06, hover-sibling closeout) feed the -hover/-hover-gradient custom-property siblings via the SAME 5-arg sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls() call, consumed by a new :hover/:focus-visible rule in style.css.
progress-bar.absentWhy: The step navigation, progress bar and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

saved-dot.label: Saved-progress dot
saved-dot._note: The small dot beside the saved-progress notice (Spec 04 FR-4-9). Printed only when savedProgress is on; a preset slug or a custom hex, emitted as a scoped rule on the form uid class.

field-input.label: Field controls
field-input._note: The focus state paints on the focused control (render.php via includes/forms/field-focus-css.php): background, border colour and width on :focus, and the ring through the focus system's --sgs-focus-halo / --sgs-focus-ring contract properties on :focus-visible. fieldFocusRingStyle (outset | inset) picks which side of the border the ring paints; the site focus outline is kept transparent so forced-colours mode still shows an indicator.

field-label.label: Field label
field-label._note: Typography only (labelFontSize and the rest of the label* set; labelFloatedFontSize is the size once a floating label has moved up on focus or fill, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__label). The class is rendered by the child field blocks: as a <label> by includes/forms/field-render-helpers.php::field_label and as a <legend> by form-field-checkbox, form-field-radio and form-field-tiles, so one class-only selector serves both tags.

tile-icon.label: Tile icon
tile-icon._note: Typography only (tileIcon* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-tile__icon). The class is emitted by the child sgs/form-field-tiles block, which declares no typography attributes of its own; the parent's uid class is an ancestor of every tile, so the scoped rule reaches it.

tile-label.label: Tile label
tile-label._note: Typography only (tileLabel* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-tile__label). The class is emitted by the child sgs/form-field-tiles block. The selected-state bold in style.css stays a higher-specificity rule on the 'background' tile style: it is the non-colour selected cue (WCAG 1.4.1), so it outranks tileLabelFontWeight in that one state.

consent-text.label: Consent text
consent-text._note: Typography and colour (consent* family and consentColour, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__consent-text). The class is emitted by the child sgs/form-field-consent block, which declares no typography attributes of its own.

review-term.label: Review term
review-term._note: Typography only (reviewTerm* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-review__term). The <dt> is created by view.js inside the sgs/form-review list, which sits inside the form wrapper that carries the uid class, so the scoped rule reaches it.

nav-button.label: Step buttons
nav-button._note: Typography of the multi-step Previous and Next buttons (.sgs-form__button--prev, .sgs-form__button--next). The submit button has its own submit* surface.

help-text.label: Help text
help-text._note: Typography only (helpText* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__help and .{uid} .sgs-form-field__file-hint). The help paragraph is emitted by field_label/field_help in field-render-helpers.php and the file size hint by sgs/form-field-file; neither child declares typography attributes.

error-text.label: Error text
error-text._note: Typography only (errorText* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__error and .{uid} .sgs-form-field__error-message). Both are the inline validation message lines under a field.

file-status.label: File upload status
file-status._note: Typography only (fileStatus* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-file__preview and .{uid} .sgs-form-file__progress). Both are emitted by the child sgs/form-field-file block.

review-heading.label: Review heading
review-heading._note: Typography only (reviewHeading* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-review__heading). The heading is emitted by the child sgs/form-review block, as a heading element whose level the block sets.

review-detail.label: Review answer
review-detail._note: Typography only (reviewDetail* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-review__detail). The answer <dd> is built by view.js::populateReview, beside the reviewTerm surface.

step-label.label: Step label
step-label._note: Typography only (stepLabel* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form__progress-step-label). The label beside each multi-step progress number; the active-step bold in style.css stays as the non-colour active cue. stepLabelColour is the colour of the labels of steps that are not the active one (render.php scoped rule on .{uid} .sgs-form__progress-step:not(.sgs-form__progress-step--active) .sgs-form__progress-step-label); unset keeps the stylesheet's muted token.
step-label.absentWhy: The step navigation, progress bar and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

step-counter.label: Step counter
step-counter._note: Typography and colour (stepCounter* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form__step-counter). view.js keeps the text in step with the current step.
step-counter.absentWhy: The counter prints only for a multi-step form with the Step counter switch on.

saved-notice.label: Saved-progress notice
saved-notice._note: Typography only (savedNotice* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form__saved-notice). Printed only when savedProgress is on.
saved-notice.absentWhy: The notice prints only when Save progress is on, and the single-step fixture leaves it off.

required-mark.label: Required mark
required-mark._note: The asterisk beside a required field's label, emitted by includes/forms/field-render-helpers.php::field_label and by the checkbox field.

optional-tag.label: Optional tag
optional-tag._note: The tag after the label of a field that is not required, text from optionalText (a content attribute), printed on fields whose optionalTag is on by includes/forms/field-render-helpers.php::field_optional_tag and by the checkbox and tiles legends. Typography is the optional* family (render.php sgs_typography_css_rule); colour is optionalColour.

file-zone-box.label: Upload zone box
file-zone-box._note: The upload zone's box (padding, border width, style and corner radius, gap). Its border and fill colours are fileLabelBorderColour* and fileLabelBackgroundColour*. render.php prints it with sgs_emit_responsive_css and sgs_border_element_decls under the form's scope.

file-zone-icon.label: Upload zone icon
file-zone-icon._note: The Lucide icon chosen on an upload field (zoneIcon). fileIconBoxSize sets the holder's width and height; the drawing's size is fileIconSize.

file-zone-icon-drawing.label: Upload zone icon drawing
file-zone-icon-drawing._note: The icon drawing inside the holder; width and height share fileIconSize.

step-buttons.label: Next and Submit buttons
step-buttons._note: nextButtonFill (per device, true) makes the Next and Submit buttons share the remaining width of the buttons row (flex 1 1 0%).

nav-icon-gap.label: Step-button icon gap
nav-icon-gap._note: Printed only when navIcon is set.

nav-icon.label: Step-button icon
nav-icon._note: Lucide icon on Next and Submit, mirrored before the label on Previous. The same size sets the height.

file-button.label: File upload button
file-button._note: Typography only (fileButton* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__file-button). The Choose file cue inside the panel-style upload zone.

file-prompt.label: File upload prompt
file-prompt._note: Typography only (filePrompt* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__file-label). The upload zone prompt text.

grid-column-heading.label: Grid column heading
grid-column-heading._note: Typography only (gridColHeading* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__column-heading). The micro-label above a field in a table-style grid.

grid-row-heading.label: Grid row heading
grid-row-heading._note: Typography only (gridRowHeading* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form-field__row-heading). The label in the gutter beside a field in a table-style grid.

step-number.label: Progress step number
step-number._note: Typography only (stepNumber* family, render.php sgs_typography_css_rule on .{uid} .sgs-form__progress-step-number). The number inside each multi-step progress bubble. stepNumberInactiveBackground fills the bubble of a step that is neither active nor completed (render.php scoped rule); unset keeps it unfilled.
step-number.absentWhy: The step navigation, progress bar and step labels print only for a multi-step form (more than one sgs/form-step).

progressFill.description: How far the progress fill runs. current = the step being shown counts (step 1 of 5 shows 20%). completed = only finished steps count (0% on step 1, 100% on the last step).

stepNumberCompletedBackground.description: Background of the number bubble of a step already passed: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the same as the active step.

stepNumberCompletedColour.description: Colour of the number or check mark inside the bubble of a step already passed: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the same as the active step.

stepCompletedIcon.description: What a completed step's bubble shows: its number, or a check mark. The step name stays in the button's accessible name either way.

actionsSticky.description: Pins the buttons row to the bottom of the viewport while the form is on screen, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each true (sticky) or false. A blank device follows the one above it. Empty = not sticky anywhere.

actionsStickyBackground.description: Background of the sticky buttons row: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = transparent.

actionsStickyBorderColour.description: Colour of the 1px line along the top of the sticky buttons row: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = no line.

actionsStickyPadding.description: Padding of the sticky buttons row, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the stylesheet's top padding only.

actionsStickyShadow.description: Shadow shape of the sticky buttons row (a preset slug or layers). Empty = none.

actionsStickyShadowColour.description: Shadow colour of the sticky buttons row. Empty = the shadow's own colour.

actionsStickyBleed.description: A CSS length (for example 22px): the sticky row gets that much negative side margin so it spans a padded form card edge to edge. Set it to the card's side padding. Empty = no bleed.

actionsFlexWrap.description: Whether the Back, Next and Submit buttons wrap onto further rows when they overrun the row. Empty keeps the stylesheet's own behaviour.

formIsLinked.description: True only when formId was set by the CPT picker (Phase 1, Spec 42) — the unambiguous discriminator between 'never linked to a sgs_form post' (legacy/free-text formId, renders own InnerBlocks) and 'linked, but the reference is now broken' (trashed/unpublished sgs_form post, renders the two-audience degrade message). Never set true by hand-authoring; only the picker's onChange writes it.

nextLabel.description: Words on a multi-step form's Next button. Empty = Next.

prevLabel.description: Words on a multi-step form's Previous button. Empty = Previous.

successMessage.default: Thank you! Your submission has been received.

successRedirectSource.description: Where the form redirects after a successful submission: '' (the typed successRedirect) or post:<id> (a page or post on this site, followed by ID). Resolved by includes/helpers-link-source.php, then checked with wp_validate_redirect(); the typed successRedirect is the fallback.

submitColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the submit button's text (background-clip:text) instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over submitColour at render time (D636/778879732 gradient rollout finish, 2026-09-04). Not mapped in submit-button's attrMap: css:background-image is already claimed by submitBackgroundGradient on this same element (JSON keys are unique) — render.php resolves the runtime collision via the D942 background-color:transparent cancellation, but if an operator sets BOTH this AND submitBackground/submitBackgroundGradient simultaneously, the background paint wins (documented trade-off, see render.php comment).

submitColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of submitColourHover. Non-empty wins over submitColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

submitBackgroundHover.description: Submit button background colour on :hover/:focus-visible (Case C fill-helper adoption, 2026-09-06). Falls back to submitBackground, then the style variant class default, when unset.

submitBackgroundHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the submit button's :hover/:focus-visible background. Non-empty wins over submitBackgroundHover; falls back to submitBackgroundGradient, then submitBackground, then none.

submitLiftHover.description: Raises the submit button by this many px on hover and keyboard focus (0-24; 0 = off).

submitShadow.description: The submit button's resting shadow shape (a preset slug or layers). Empty = none.

submitShadowHover.description: The submit button's hover shadow shape. Empty = the automatic lift of the resting shadow (submitShadowLiftOnHover).

submitPadding.description: Submit button padding as a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the stylesheet's 0.75rem 2rem.

submitMinHeight.description: Submit button minimum height in px. 0 = the stylesheet's 44px.

fieldBackground.description: Ground of every text-like field control (input, select, textarea): a palette slug or colour. Empty = the stylesheet's surface colour.

fieldFocusBackground.description: Ground of a focused field control: a palette slug or colour. Empty = the control keeps its resting ground.

fieldFocusBorderColour.description: Border colour of a focused field control. Empty = the site focus-ring colour, or the focus ring colour when a ring is set.

fieldFocusBorderWidth.description: Border width of a focused field control as a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the resting width.

fieldFocusRingColour.description: Colour of the ring around a focused field control. Setting it replaces the site focus outline and glow on field controls with this ring. Empty = the site focus ring, unchanged.

fieldFocusRingWidth.description: Thickness of the focused-field ring in px. 0 = 2px once a ring colour is set.

fieldFocusRingStyle.description: Whether the focused-field ring sits outside the border (outset) or inside it (inset). Empty = outset.

labelFloatedFontSize.description: Font size of a floating label once it has moved up (field focused or filled), per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the Label font size, or the stylesheet's 0.8125rem when that is unset.

labelFloatedColour.description: Colour of a floating label while its field is focused: a palette slug or a colour value. Empty = the stylesheet's primary-dark.

labelFloatedOffset.description: Distance from the top of the field to a floated label (CSS top): a CSS length such as 9px. Empty = the stylesheet's floated position (0).

fieldTextColour.description: Text colour of every field control. Empty = the stylesheet's text colour.

fieldPlaceholderColour.description: Placeholder colour of every field control, via --sgs-field-placeholder-colour. Empty = the stylesheet's muted text colour.

fieldBorderColour.description: Resting border colour of every field control, via --sgs-field-edge-colour so the focus ring and the error border still win. Empty = the stylesheet's border colour.

fieldBorderWidth.description: Field control border width as a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the stylesheet's 1px.

fieldBorderStyle.description: Field control border style. Empty = solid when a width is set.

fieldBorderRadius.description: Field control corner radius, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}. Empty = the stylesheet's small radius.

fieldPadding.description: Field control padding, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the stylesheet's 0.75rem 1rem.

fieldMinHeight.description: Minimum height of single-line field controls (input and select), per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length ('52px', '3.25rem') or a bare number of px. The value is the height, even below 44px. Empty = the stylesheet's 44px.

fieldTextareaMinHeight.description: Minimum height of a textarea, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. The value is the height, even below 44px. Empty = the stylesheet's 100px.

fieldFontSize.description: Font size of every field control, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's small preset size.

submitAlign.description: Where the submit button row sits: start, center, end or space-between (the buttons-row note at the left, the buttons at the right). Empty = the stylesheet's end. A narrow form container stacks the button full width unless stretchButtonsNarrow is off.

stretchButtonsNarrow.description: When on (default), a narrow form container (400px or less) stacks the buttons full width with the primary action on top. Off keeps the buttons at their normal width and order.

progressBarColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the progress bar with a gradient instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over progressBarColour at render time.

progressBarColourHover.description: Progress bar fill colour on :hover/:focus-visible (hover-sibling closeout, 2026-09-06). Falls back to progressBarColour, then the CSS default, when unset.

progressBarColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the progress bar's :hover/:focus-visible fill. Non-empty wins over progressBarColourHover; falls back to progressBarColourGradient, then none.

optionalText.description: Text of the tag printed after the label of each field that switches its own Optional tag on (for example "Optional"). Empty = "Optional". Read by includes/forms/field-render-helpers.php::field_optional_tag through the form's render scope.

requiredMarkGap.description: Space between a field label and its required mark or optional tag, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's 0.25em.

optionalColour.description: Colour of the optional tag after a field label. Empty = the label colour.

fileLabelPadding.description: Padding of the upload zone, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a box {top,right,bottom,left}. Empty = the stylesheet's 2rem.

fileLabelBorderWidth.description: Border width of the upload zone as a box {top,right,bottom,left}, or one box per device. Empty = the stylesheet's 2px.

fileLabelBorderStyle.description: Border style of the upload zone once a width is set. Colour is fileLabelBorderColour.

fileLabelBorderRadius.description: Corner radius of the upload zone, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}. Empty = the stylesheet's medium radius.

fileLabelGap.description: Space between the icon, the prompt and the hint inside the upload zone, per device: each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's 0.5rem (1rem in the row layout).

fileIconBoxSize.description: Width and height of the upload zone's icon holder, per device: each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the icon's own size.

fileIconSize.description: Width and height of the upload zone's icon drawing, per device: each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = 24px.

fileIconBackground.description: Fill behind the upload zone's icon. Empty = none.

fileIconColour.description: Colour of the upload zone's icon. Empty = the zone's text colour.

fileIconRadius.description: Corner radius of the upload zone's icon holder, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each {topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft}. Empty = square.

notifyEmail.description: Owner notification recipient. Blank falls back to the Site Info email, then admin_email (Sgs_Mailer::owner_recipient()).

confirmationEmail.description: When true, the submitter also receives a confirmation email at their submitted email field (only when one is present and valid).

confirmationSubject.description: Confirmation email subject. Blank uses a sensible default.

confirmationMessage.description: Confirmation email body (plain text, wrapped in paragraphs). Blank uses a sensible default.

fieldColumnsFrom.description: The form's own CONTAINER width (not the viewport) at which half/third fields sit side by side — a @container sgs-form threshold (style.css). Default 560 matches the unmodified stylesheet exactly (no modifier class emitted). Lower it when the form is nested in a column narrower than 560px (a two-column page split, a sidebar) so half-width fields still pair up there.

layout.description: composite wrapper review (P2-2, container's layout-default fix): sgs/form routes through SGS_Container_Wrapper::render() the same way sgs/container does, so an untouched form would otherwise inherit container's new 'flex'/row default and lay its fields out side-by-side. Form fields are unambiguously vertical, so this block declares its own explicit 'stack' default rather than sharing the primitive's.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.

consentColour.description: Colour of the consent checkbox text. Empty = inherit the form's text colour.

stepLayout.description: How a multi-step form's progress steps sit: stacked (number above label) or inline (number beside label, steps sharing the width equally).

stepCounter.description: Show a 'Step 2 of 4' counter above the fields of a multi-step form.

stepCounterLabel.description: Wording of the step counter: %1$d is the current step, %2$d the number of steps.

stepCounterColour.description: Colour of the step counter. Empty = the form's text colour.

requiredMarkColour.description: Colour of the required asterisk beside a field label. Empty = the stylesheet's text colour.

labelColour.description: Colour of every field label and of the checkbox, radio and tiles legends. Empty = the stylesheet's label colour.

navIcon.description: Lucide icon slug printed on the Next and Submit buttons after the label, and mirrored before the label on Previous. Empty = no icon.

navIconSize.description: Width and height in px of the step-button icon.

navIconGap.description: Gap between a step button's icon and its label: a spacing token number or a length such as 10px.

navIconStrokeWidth.description: Stroke width of the step-button icon. Empty = the icon's own 2.

nextButtonFill.description: Makes the Next and Submit buttons fill the rest of the buttons row, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each true (fill) or false (content width). A blank device follows the one above it. Empty = content width everywhere.

actionsAlignItems.description: Cross-axis alignment of the buttons in the buttons row, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each flex-start, center, flex-end, stretch or baseline. Empty = the stylesheet's default (buttons stretch to the tallest one).

actionsGap.description: Gap between the buttons in the buttons row, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's own gap.

stepLabelColourCompleted.description: Colour of the label of a completed step: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the not-active label colour.

stepLabelFontWeightCompleted.description: Font weight of the label of a completed step. Empty = the label's own weight.

actionsNote.description: A short note at the left of the buttons row, plain inline formatting only. Empty = none.

stepCounterNameSuffix.description: Wording printed after the step counter that carries the current step's name: %3$s is the name, for example ' · %3$s'. Empty = no name beside the counter.

stepCounterNameHidden.description: Hides the step name beside the counter, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each true (hidden) or false (shown). A blank device follows the one above it. Empty = shown everywhere.

stepNamesHidden.description: Hides the step names in the progress steps, per device, leaving the step numbers: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each true (hidden) or false (shown). A blank device follows the one above it. Empty = shown everywhere (a form narrower than 480px still hides them).

requiredMarkHidden.description: Hides the asterisk after a required field's label, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each true (hidden) or false (shown). A blank device follows the one above it. Empty = shown everywhere.

progressTrackColour.description: Colour of the track behind the progress fill: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = no track colour.

progressTrackHeight.description: Height of the progress track and its fill, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's 4px fill.

stepLabelColour.description: Colour of the labels of the steps that are not the active one: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the stylesheet's muted token.

stepLabelColourActive.description: Colour of the active step's label: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the stylesheet's text token.

stepNumberInactiveBackground.description: Background of the number bubble of a step that is neither active nor completed: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = unfilled.

actionsNoteHidden.description: Hides the note beside the buttons, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each true (hidden) or false (shown). A blank device follows the one above it. Empty = shown everywhere.

statusRowWrap.description: Whether the step counter and saved-progress notice wrap onto two lines when they overrun the row. Empty keeps the stylesheet's own behaviour.

statusRowGap.description: Gap between the lines of the counter row (and between its items), per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's 0.5rem.

actionsTopPadding.description: Space above the buttons row, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = the stylesheet's spacing-30 (1rem). Applies when the row is not sticky; a sticky row uses its own padding setting.

actionsTopMargin.description: Margin above the buttons row, per device: {desktop,tablet,mobile}, each a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = 0. The form's fields sit in a grid with a row gap, so this margin adds to that gap.

actionsBorderTopWidth.description: Thickness of the divider line along the top of the buttons row: a CSS length or a bare number of px. Empty = no line.

actionsBorderTopStyle.description: Line style of the buttons row divider. Applies once a width is set.

actionsBorderTopColour.description: Colour of the buttons row divider: a palette slug or a custom colour. Empty = the text colour. On a sticky device the sticky row's own line colour (actionsStickyBorderColour) wins when it is set.

statusRowMarginBottom.description: Space below the counter row (the step counter and saved-progress notice). Empty = the stylesheet's 1rem.

actionsNoteFirstStepOnly.description: On a multi-step form, show the buttons-row note on the first step only.
